This is characteristic of a strategy-proof mechanism like Deferred Acceptance. In such mechanisms, truth-telling is optimal: submitting my true preferences ensures I get my most preferred school among those actually obtainable to me, with no benefit from strategic misrepresentation.

My true preference order is w > x > y > z, and I should submit this truthfully regardless of others' preferences or my priority levels, since misrepresenting could only hurt me (by potentially causing me to receive a less preferred obtainable school) and never helps.
